name: Hair texture powder / sea salt spray
lead: Texture powders and sea salt sprays are hair styling products used to add volume, grip and a matte, tousled look. Sea salt spray is a salt-and-water mist applied to damp hair, while texture powder is a fine dry powder dusted at the roots.

Wikipedia's overview of styling products lists volumisers, which add temporary volume to thin or flat hair through humectants and coating polymers [1]. It does not specifically cover sea salt spray or texture powders [1]. No clinical studies of either product were found.
On looksmax.org users share homemade sea salt sprays and discuss them for adding waviness [3].

paras: General styling products work by coating strands with polymers, wax or oil, or by swelling the strand with humectants [1]. Volumisers are described as products that add temporary volume and body to thin or flat hair [1]. Sea salt sprays and texture powders are commercial products in that wider category, but the sources reviewed do not detail their formulations.

One looksmax.org thread presents a homemade version of sea salt spray, using water, salt and a little olive oil in a spray bottle, applied to hair after washing and scrunched in to encourage curl [3]. The author reports tighter curls afterwards, while another user replies that the hair was already curly [3].

Wikipedia notes that most styling products do not damage hair when applied properly, but any product can dry hair, and some ingredients can strip oils or build up and cause dullness, dryness or breakage [1]. Conditioning overviews describe heat as a separate source of damage [2].

lore.intro: Sea salt spray appears in hair-texture threads, including a do-it-yourself recipe presented as a cheaper alternative to commercial sprays. [3]

claims.claim: A homemade sea salt spray can make hair wavier or curlier.
claims.believers: The poster reports that his wavy hair became tighter curly after using it, while a replier says the hair was already curly. [3]
claims.experts: No published studies have tested sea salt sprays for curl formation; reference sources on styling products do not describe them. [1]

quick.overview:
Sea salt spray and texture powder are styling products meant to give hair volume, grip and a matte look. Sea salt spray is applied wet and powder is dusted dry.

Users share DIY sea salt sprays online. No clinical studies were found.
quick.mechanism: Styling products generally coat or swell the hair strand to create temporary body. The sources reviewed do not describe the specific formulations.
quick.risks: Styling products can dry hair or build up and cause dullness or breakage, according to Wikipedia. No specific safety studies on these two product types were found.
